Phase 2: CopilotKit Self-Hosted Runtime (use existing models)
description:
Implement CopilotKit with self-hosted runtime that uses our existing models from the database instead of Copilot Cloud.

## Why Phase 2 Instead of Cloud?

- Uses our existing 25+ provider configurations
- Uses our existing auth configs and model discovery
- No external API key dependencies
- Full control over LLM routing

## Architecture

```
React Frontend
  └── CopilotKit (runtimeUrl="/api/copilot")
        └── Go Backend /api/copilot/* 
              └── Uses ModelStore + AuthConfigStore
                    └── Calls provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
```

## Key Differences from Phase 1 Plan

- Replace VITE_COPILOT_CLOUD_API_KEY with runtimeUrl pointing to our backend
- Implement /api/copilot/chat/completions endpoint in Go
- Reuse existing chat completions infrastructure
- No Node.js sidecar needed if we implement the protocol natively

title: SSE streaming chat proxy
description: Add streaming support to chat proxy. The current chat.go reads entire response body with io.ReadAll() and writes it back at once. CopilotKit requires SSE streaming (text/event-stream) for chat completions. Create internal/api/chat_stream.go with streaming proxy that pipes SSE chunks using http.Flusher. Prerequisite for q2y.

title: Extend ChatRequest with tools/stream fields
description: The current ChatRequest struct only has Model and Messages. CopilotKit sends tools, tool_choice, and stream in every request. Extend struct to include Stream bool, Tools json.RawMessage, ToolChoice json.RawMessage. Update proxy payload construction to forward these fields. Handle tool_calls in streamed response chunks.

Add migration for is_default column. Add Set as Default toggle in Models UI.

title: Copilot system prompt design
description: Design and implement dynamic system prompt for CopilotKit. The prompt describes Bot Portal as an AI agent management platform, lists available entities (Agents, Models, Auth Configs), available actions (CRUD, navigation), and injects current state summary (counts of agents/models/configs). Inject as first message if not present. Make configurable via COPILOT_SYSTEM_PROMPT env var.

title: SSE streaming chat proxy
description: Add streaming support to chat proxy. Current chat.go reads entire response with io.ReadAll(). CopilotKit requires SSE streaming. Create internal/api/chat_stream.go with SSE proxy function. Set Content-Type: text/event-stream, pipe chunks with http.Flusher, handle data: [DONE] termination. Preserve non-streaming path for backward compat.

title: Research: Can we implement CopilotRuntime protocol natively in Go?
description:
Investigate the CopilotKit CopilotRuntime protocol to determine if we can implement it natively in Go without Node.js sidecar.

## Research Tasks

1. Examine CopilotKit runtime source code protocol
2. Identify required endpoints (/v1/copilot/chat/completions, etc.)
3. Check if protocol is OpenAI-compatible or custom
4. Determine feasibility of Go-native implementation

## Expected Outcome

- Document the protocol requirements
- Decide: Go-native vs Node.js sidecar approach
- Create implementation tasks based on decision
close_reason: CopilotKit v1 uses GraphQL protocol (runtime-client-gql + urql). Cannot implement natively in Go. Solution: thin Node.js runtime using @copilotkit/runtime + OpenAIAdapter with baseURL pointing to Go backend's /api/chat/completions. Go backend needs streaming (eq4) and tools forwarding (psn) to be OpenAI-compatible.

title: Bot Portal MVP - Agent Management & A2A Message Router
description: Build a web portal to manage multiple zeroclaw AI agents running as Docker containers. Portal serves as A2A message router with channels (agent1::agent2, general), message logging, and agent configuration. Go backend + React frontend + SQLite.

title: Project scaffolding: Go module, directory structure, Makefile, docker-compose
description: Initialize Go module, create directory structure per ADR-001, set up Makefile with build/run/test targets, create docker-compose.yml for dev environment.

title: Fix predictable bearer token generation
description: internal/store/agents.go:144-147 — Token generated as agent_{id}_{timestamp}, trivially guessable. Fix: use crypto/rand to generate 32-byte random hex token.

title: Add bearer token authentication to all A2A endpoints
description: internal/a2a/router.go + internal/api/router.go — POST /tasks, GET /tasks/{id}, GET /tasks/{id}/stream, POST /tasks/{id}/cancel are all unauthenticated. Any caller can create/read/cancel tasks. Fix: add bearer token validation middleware checking Authorization header against known agent tokens.

title: Fix splitChannelID: splits by midpoint instead of :: delimiter
description: internal/a2a/router.go:306-314 — splitChannelID splits by string midpoint, not by :: delimiter. Direct channel routing is completely broken. Fix: use strings.SplitN(channelID, "::", 2) and return the part that isn't senderID.

title: Fix HandleTaskGet/HandleTaskStream path value mismatch
description: internal/a2a/router.go uses req.PathValue("id") but api/router.go:106-107 extracts ID via string slicing into context. PathValue returns empty so GET /tasks/{id} always fails. Fix: use consistent ID extraction — either http.ServeMux patterns with {id} or read from context.

title: Fix GenerateBearerToken called before agent row exists
description: internal/api/router.go:193-194 — GenerateBearerToken runs UPDATE on agent that doesn't exist yet (Create hasn't been called). Token silently lost. Fix: generate token inline before Create, or call GenerateBearerToken after Create.

title: Fix deleteAgent double HTTP response write
description: internal/api/router.go:262-272 — deleteAgent calls stopAgent which writes HTTP response, then tries to write again (StatusNoContent). Causes panic or corrupted response. Fix: extract stop logic into non-HTTP helper, call from both stopAgent and deleteAgent.

title: Fix restartAgent blocking sleep in HTTP handler
description: internal/api/router.go:295-298 — restartAgent calls time.Sleep(500ms) in HTTP handler goroutine. Doesn't actually restart anything, just wastes resources. Fix: call Docker restart or remove sleep.

title: Add database indexes on task_logs
description: internal/store/sqlite.go:47-58 — No indexes on task_logs.channel_id, task_logs.sender_id, task_logs.created_at. All queries filter/sort by these. Fix: add CREATE INDEX statements in migrations.

title: Fix silently discarded json.Unmarshal errors in store
description: internal/store/agents.go:39,71,74,104,107,119 + channels.go:50 + messages.go:37-38 — Multiple json.Unmarshal calls with errors silently discarded. Corrupt JSON produces nil data with no indication. Fix: check and log/return unmarshal errors.

title: Implement Docker manager with docker/go-client SDK
description: internal/docker/manager.go — All methods are stubbed returning errors. Agent start/stop/restart in api/router.go never calls Docker. Implement with github.com/docker/docker/client: CreateContainer, StartContainer, StopContainer, RestartContainer, RemoveContainer, GetContainerStatus.

title: Data models & SQLite storage layer
description: Define Agent (with cached AgentCard), Channel, TaskLog domain models. Implement SQLite store with migrations. CRUD for agents, channels, task logs. TaskLog stores full task lifecycle (status, messages, artifacts) per channel.

title: Replace default http.ServeMux with dedicated mux + middleware
description: internal/api/router.go:56-80 — Uses http.DefaultServeMux (global, no middleware, no CORS). Can't add auth middleware; frontend won't work cross-origin in dev. Fix: use dedicated http.ServeMux or chi router with middleware support.

title: Add unit and integration tests
description: Zero test files in entire codebase. ADR checklist requires tests covering happy path + edge cases. Add tests for: store CRUD operations, A2A routing logic, splitChannelID/ChannelID helpers, API handler responses, token generation.

title: Fix Dockerfile CGO_ENABLED=0 incompatible with go-sqlite3
description: Dockerfile:17 — CGO_ENABLED=0 but mattn/go-sqlite3 requires CGO. Build will fail. Fix: either set CGO_ENABLED=1 and install gcc musl-dev in builder stage, or switch to modernc.org/sqlite (pure Go).

title: Docker container lifecycle manager
description: Implement Docker Engine API integration using Go SDK. Support create/start/stop/restart/remove containers. Each agent container gets AGENT_ID, PORTAL_URL, PORTAL_BEARER_TOKEN env vars. Mount config.toml with A2A config (agent_card, peers, skills). Stream container logs. Expose port 9000 per container.

title: REST API for agent and channel management
description: Implement REST endpoints: agent CRUD, start/stop/restart, channel listing, message history. Use chi or stdlib mux. Include SSE endpoint for real-time message streaming.

title: A2A message router: client + server + channel routing
description: Core feature. Implement Google A2A standard integration. Portal acts as A2A server: POST /tasks (receive tasks from agents), GET /tasks/{id} (task status), GET /tasks/{id}/stream (SSE TaskUpdate stream), POST /tasks/{id}/cancel. Portal acts as A2A client: POST /tasks to forward to target agents, GET /tasks/{id}/stream to subscribe to agent updates. Serve AgentCard at /.well-known/agent.json. Route by channel: agent1::agent2 for direct, general for broadcast. Bearer token auth. Log all Tasks and TaskMessages.

title: A2A protocol types (Google A2A standard)
description: Define Go types matching zeroclaw's Google A2A implementation: AgentCard (name, description, version, capabilities, authentication, endpoints, skills), Task (id, status, created_at, updated_at, messages, artifacts), TaskMessage (role: user|agent, content, timestamp), TaskUpdate (task_id, status, message, artifact), Artifact (id, type, name, content), CreateTaskRequest/Response. Also A2APeer and A2AConfig for peer management.

title: React frontend: dashboard, agent management, message viewer
description: Set up React+TypeScript+Vite. Build pages: Dashboard (agent overview), Agent Detail (config editor, logs), Message Viewer (real-time A2A message log with channel filter), Channel View. Use SSE for real-time updates.

title: Integration testing with mock agents
description: Create a simple mock agent Docker image for testing. Write integration tests for: agent registration, A2A message routing, channel creation, message logging. Test direct and broadcast channels.

title: Fix sendTaskToAgent: request body is nil, tasks never forwarded
description: internal/a2a/router.go:247-253 — sendTaskToAgent marshals body but sets httpReq.Body = nil. Core routing is broken. Fix: use bytes.NewReader(body) as request body in http.NewRequest.
